theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are the confirmed leader with the highest score, the joint-highest durability bar (0.66) alongside Big Banks, near-full breadth (0.933), eligible status, and a non-crowded reading (crowding_z 0.54). The absolute-trend gate is validated as risk control on this market, and the leg is eligible, so the one defensible lean is to retain exposure to the dominant trend while respecting that the rank itself does not forecast return.
theses.dissent: The Gold Miners r10 is slightly negative (-0.0054) and the hurst_tag is mixed, so near-term momentum within the theme is not confirming; the fully unscheduled macro backdrop (geopolitics 4, markets 4) could flip the safety/precious-metals bid quickly.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the closest challenger, eligible with a score of 1.627, strong breadth (0.917), a solid durability bar (0.63), and no crowding flag.
